title: *National Adaptation Plan to Climate Change (2022-2026)*
organization: DRC Ministry of Environment and Sustainable Development / UNDP support
methodology: Existing vulnerability assessments; CRU and model-ensemble climate information; RCP4.5/RCP8.5; policy consultations
limitations: NAP explicitly notes reliance on older TNC/CRU information and need for updated, targeted studies.

title: *Contribution Déterminée à l'échelle Nationale révisée*
organization: DRC Ministry of Environment and Sustainable Development
methodology: National mitigation/adaptation planning, sector analysis, stakeholder revision process
limitations: Policy commitments and financing needs are not evidence of implementation or outcomes.

title: *Independent Country Programme Evaluation: Democratic Republic of Congo*
geographic_coverage: National plus fieldwork in five provinces
methodology: OECD/DAC-oriented evaluation; document and portfolio review; 362 stakeholders; field visits; qualitative/quantitative triangulation
limitations: Security/access constraints limited fieldwork; North Kivu fieldwork was limited to Goma; women were about one-third of interviewees.

title: *Climate, Peace and Security in Eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo* (SIPRI2)
temporal_coverage: Literature to early 2025; workshop May 2024; KIIs Oct. 2024
methodology: Literature synthesis; workshop with 50+ local stakeholders; five key-informant interviews; climate-security pathway framework
limitations: Qualitative and geographically restricted; cannot establish national causal effects.

title: *Climate Related Security Risks in Eastern DRC: Local Perspectives from North and South Kivu Provinces*
organization: Folke Bernadotte Academy, Réseau CREF, Strong Roots Congo
geographic_coverage: North and South Kivu; Ruzizi evidence
temporal_coverage: Workshop Mar. 2023 plus cited local studies
methodology: Two-day multidisciplinary exploratory workshop and local research presentations
limitations: Explicitly non-exhaustive; several pathway findings reflect participant expertise and presented research rather than a causal study by the report itself.

title: *Climate, Peace and Security Fact Sheet: Democratic Republic of the Congo* (NUPI3)
methodology: Research synthesis of climate-security mechanisms and recommendations
limitations: Broad synthesis; some claims are based on secondary evidence and should not override more recent humanitarian data.

title: *Joint News Release - WFP/FAO: Millions Trapped in Deepening Hunger Crisis in the DRC...* (World Food Programme1)
geographic_coverage: National with focus on North/South Kivu, Ituri, Tanganyika
methodology: Latest IPC update plus agency operational evidence
limitations: Humanitarian situation data, not a causal climate attribution study.

title: *DR Congo Emergency* (UNHCR4)
methodology: UNHCR population/operational reporting and appeal information
limitations: Page combines stock figures, projections and appeal information from different dates; figures must retain their stated reference dates. Publisher passage access failed during the 26 October 2026 review; no snippet was used as verification.

title: *DRC Urban Flood Resilience Project (P508410), Appraisal PID* (World Bank5)
methodology: Project appraisal, DRM assessment and proposed results framework
limitations: Mostly intended mechanisms and targets; not evidence that resilience outcomes were achieved.

title: *DRC Urban Flood Resilience Project - Implementation Status & Results Report* (World Bank6)
methodology: First ISR; indicator and disbursement monitoring
limitations: Very early implementation stage; “satisfactory” rating does not establish final effectiveness.

title: *DRC: Requests for ECF and Resilience and Sustainability Facility Arrangements - Staff Report*, Annex II (IMF7)
methodology: IMF staff analysis drawing on climate datasets, World Bank CCDR, C-PIMA, authorities and other sources
limitations: Secondary synthesis for several climate estimates; some implementation statements are authority-reported. Publisher passage access failed during the 26 October 2026 review; no snippet was used as verification.

title: *IMF Executive Board Completes Third ECF Review and Second RSF Review for DRC* (IMF8)
limitations: Not an independent evaluation of climate-adaptation outcomes; programme performance is broader than climate policy.

title: Democratic Republic of Congo Level 3 Emergency - Upsurge in Conflict, Humanitarian Situation Report No. 5, 1-15 May 2025
organization: UNICEF Democratic Republic of the Congo
temporal_coverage: Humanitarian events and response reported for 1-15 May 2025, with selected response totals since the crisis began.
methodology: UNICEF situation monitoring and partner-reported humanitarian response results.
limitations: Operational reporting; some response figures are cumulative and are not independent evaluations.

title: FAO GIEWS Country Brief: Democratic Republic of the Congo (reference date 24 June 2026)
organization: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations, Global Information and Early Warning System
temporal_coverage: Seasonal crop assessments and food-security data through June 2026; rainfall outlook for June-October 2026.
methodology: FAO GIEWS synthesis of crop, forecast, IPC and supply data.
limitations: Country brief; forecast resolution and intervention impact evaluation are not provided.
